first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single person above the city, wearing a red-and-blue bodysuit, with a red-covered face and head pointing downward.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: The sky above the cluster of buildings, covered by dark and light gray cloud masses.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: A collection of brown, gray, and dark-colored buildings of varying heights, with window grids, flat roofs, and some stepped tops.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A gray road extending into the distance between the central buildings, with a visible intersection.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree crowns distributed along both sides of the road and in open spaces between buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A background group of cars on the central road, with small outlines of light-colored, dark-colored, and some yellow vehicle roofs visible.

entities.name: Distant water surface
entities.identification: A gray-blue body of water on the image-left, behind the nearby cluster of buildings.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A partially exposed purplish-red rectangular sign face on the side of a building slightly left of center.

entities.name: Group of orange-yellow vertical light strips
entities.identification: Multiple slender orange-yellow light strips arranged side by side above the rooftop on the image-left.

entities.name: Light-colored line below the person
entities.identification: A thin gray-white line below Person A, overlaid in front of a building facade and extending toward the lower part of the image.
